evidence: src/infrastructure/in-memory-product-repository.ts: class InMemoryProductRepository implements ProductRepository and stores products in a private Map<string, Product>, which is persistence work for the infrastructure layer.
findByIds, findAll and save only read from and write to the Map. They contain no domain rules or validation.
The constructor only loads the given catalogue into the store.
parsedVerdict.reasoning: This file is a plain in-memory persistence adapter. It implements the domain port ProductRepository using a Map. Its only jobs are storing products, looking them up and listing them, which is persistence work and belongs in the infrastructure layer. It has no business rules such as pricing, validation, stock checks or invariants. It has no transport or presentation logic either. The one extra step in findByIds is removing duplicate ids with new Set(ids). That is a lookup detail, not a business rule.
